_enabled_note: Watchlist is active; ingestion remains manual. No cron, no scrapers, no automated fetches. The owner dispatches checks on cadence.

1.label: primary — load-bearing
1.policy: Adopted controls must trace to Tier 1 source. Citations in agent-safety-constitution.md / alignment-risk-policy.json should reference Tier 1 wherever possible.

2.label: practitioner
2.policy: Concrete patterns from experienced operators. Adopted only when corroborated by Tier 1 source OR by repeated practical signal in HarnessKit runs.

3.label: supporting only
3.policy: Never sole source for an adopted control. Cited for context, never as ground truth.

cadence_defaults._comment: Manual dispatch only. These are suggested intervals; the owner initiates the check.

external_research_tools._comment: Owner directive 2026-06-04. Subscriptions the owner operates MANUALLY as external research inputs only. Excluded from all automated HarnessKit plans unless a separate future approval explicitly allows API-key integration.
external_research_tools.output_handling: research notes / evidence candidates only (Tier 3 — never load-bearing); normal source verification required before any output becomes policy, eval, or skill content
external_research_tools.unblock_condition: separate future approval explicitly allowing API-key integration

ingest_note + map to alignment-risk-policy.json risk classes

ingestion_targets._comment: Where ingested notes and registries live. Phase 4 scripts populate these.

scripts_planned._comment: These do not exist yet. Phase 4 ships them.

discipline_rules: Adopted controls must trace to a Tier 1 source (or Tier 2 corroborated by run signal). Tier 3 alone is insufficient.
Rejected ideas append-only — deletion requires Owner approval and a fresh re-debate note.
Every adopted control change to a constitution / policy file requires a proposal in proposals/policy-updates/ that the owner reviews before merge.
Notes carry trust_level: untrusted_external in their frontmatter; they pass through memory-poisoning-scan.js before reaching memory layer.
No automated web fetches in Phase 3C-4. Manual cadence only.

Perplexity Pro and Grok are manual external research inputs only (see external_research_tools). Never advisors, harness/eval dependencies, hooks, registries, source of truth, or authority. No API usage, no API-key requests, no browser automation; no batch may require them. Their outputs are evidence candidates requiring normal source verification before becoming policy, eval, or skill content.

kill_switch._note: research-ingest.js + research-to-controls.js (Phase 4) exit 0 silent when DISABLED; manual reading remains possible (owner-typed prompts unaffected).
